tool_calls.code:
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
df = pd.read_csv('daily_cost_4.csv')

# For each (account, service), compute median and robust z-score
df['median'] = df.groupby(['SubAccountName','ServiceName'])['BilledCost'].transform('median')
df['mad'] = df.groupby(['SubAccountName','ServiceName'])['BilledCost'].transform(lambda s: (s - s.median()).abs().median())
df['z'] = 0.6745 * (df['BilledCost'] - df['median']) / df['mad'].replace(0, np.nan)
df = df.sort_values('z', ascending=False)
print(df[['ChargePeriodStart','SubAccountName','ServiceName','BilledCost','median','z']].head(15))

import pandas as pd, numpy as np
df = pd.read_csv('daily_cost_4.csv')
g = df.groupby(['SubAccountName','ServiceName'])['BilledCost']
m=g.transform('mean'); s=g.transform(lambda x: x.std())
z=(df['BilledCost']-m)/s
out=pd.concat([df, z.rename('z')],axis=1).sort_values('z',ascending=False)
print(out[['ChargePeriodStart','SubAccountName','ServiceName','BilledCost','z']].head(5))
